coverage: Every one of the 55 current unique Mythic weapon names has at least one direct forum WynnBuilder example.
interpretation_warning: Observed fields describe the dated forum corpus. Inferred candidate families are property-based research hypotheses, not tested meta rankings.

major_ids.name: Hellfire
major_ids.description: Bash is replaced by a single hit, gaining +3 radius and dealing +85%, +10%, and +60%. Boiling Blood's cooldown is set to 2s, gains +40%, +50%, and burns twice as fast for 1s, but can't slow.

major_ids.name: Living Museum
major_ids.description: Players within 10 blocks of Mirage, Shadow, or Another Self clones will get 20% resistance, and be healed 8%, 15%, or 50% max health when the respective clone is destroyed.

major_ids.name: Divine Right
major_ids.description: Your Maximum Health is reduced by 75%. For every 100 HP lost, Sacred Surge's damage is increased by 3%.

major_ids.name: Fission
major_ids.description: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

major_ids.name: Death Sentence
major_ids.description: Courage will immediately combust Guardian Angels, dealing 4000% and enkindling Buckshot's arrows with 20% Main Attack damage.

major_ids.name: Unstable Reaction
major_ids.description: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

major_ids.name: Starcrossed
major_ids.description: Hitting an enemy with Haunting Memory makes it Linked. You can have up to two targets Linked at once. When one Linked enemy takes damage, the other Linked enemy takes that damage as well. Haunted Memory's duration is increased by 5 seconds and its range is increased by 10 blocks.

major_ids.name: Earthen Splinter
major_ids.description: Quake channels nature energy into a powerful root, travelling underground and emerging under the nearest mob for 1200%.

major_ids.name: Torment Liturgy
major_ids.description: Shadow Siphon now immediately refreshes Vanish when triggered, but reduces Surprise Strike's multiplier by -30%.

major_ids.name: Guardian
major_ids.description: Devout Union gains +20% damage redirection and +4 radius.

major_ids.name: Blinding Lights
major_ids.description: All Ophanim orbs deal 250% damage, gain +5 Crystallize per hit, and instead orbit around you. Using Main Attack causes all orbs to travel faster.

major_ids.name: Efflorescence
major_ids.description: Serpent's Garden now centers to where you land with Swan Dive. Damage of Swan Dive, Serpent's Garden and Jasmine Bloom are distributed across all elements.

major_ids.name: Saviour's Sacrifice
major_ids.description: While under 50% maximum health, allies within 8 blocks gain 15% bonus damage and defence.

major_ids.name: Tidal Drift
major_ids.description: Flying Kick will instead send you forwards. This effect is limited to once per Charge cast.

major_ids.name: Dragon's Breath
major_ids.description: Buckshot will heal allies for 100% of your total Health Regen.

major_ids.name: Twisting Threads
major_ids.description: Tangled Traps ropes gain +1 range, can overlap up to 3 times, and deal 65%. Gain +12 traps with 66% duration that cannot be triggered by enemies.

major_ids.name: Transcendence
major_ids.description: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana when casted.

major_ids.name: Punishment
major_ids.description: Reflected damage blinds enemies for 1s and makes them 10% more vulnerable to attacks for 3s.

major_ids.name: Lightweight
major_ids.description: You no longer take fall damage.

major_ids.name: Gravity Well
major_ids.description: Meteor has increased blast radius and pulls enemies instead.

major_ids.name: Lifestream
major_ids.description: Blood Sorrow has 4 times the damage and overhealth, but its duration is shortened by 75%.

major_ids.name: Old Spark
major_ids.description: Whirlwind transforms into a travelling projectile, exploding on contact and knocking enemies into the air. Crouch to rise with them.

major_ids.name: Regicide
major_ids.description: You deal 2% more damage for every block you are away from your target (Max 120%).

major_ids.name: Wavebreak
major_ids.description: Meteor's  damage is replaced by  damage. Psychokinesis can bounce up to 5 times, dealing 100% and 50% area damage, as well as 200% and 100% direct hit damage, increasing by 10% after each bounce. Mana Bank gains 3 less mana from Meteor.

major_ids.name: Orbital Chain
major_ids.description: Chain Lightning hits slower, rebounds, adds 6 chains, and pulls mobs closer for a 8000% explosion spell.

major_ids.name: Outbreak
major_ids.description: When you are within Totem range, the Totem becomes Primed, adding 4% of your Poison ID every 0.25s. Hitting a Primed totem with Uproot will create a 6 block wide poison cloud instantly dealing the stored Poison.

major_ids.name: Fixate
major_ids.description: Distortion decays at a halved rate and Devitalize effects are doubled. However, Distortion effects on abilities are reduced by 40% and Meteor Shower now requires +50% Distortion per Meteor.

major_ids.name: Flain Remnants
major_ids.description: Destroying a Puppet with Friendly Fire calls forth a Remnant. (Max 5) Each Remnant lasts for 20 seconds, fires an explosive tracking projectile every second that deals 95%, and increases your Main Attack damage by 15%.

major_ids.name: Manic Edge
major_ids.description: While vanished, lose 5% of your max mana per second. Surprise Strike further increases your damage by 3% per mana lost from this effect, up to 70%.

major_ids.name: Roving Assassin
major_ids.description: Vanish will no longer block mana and health regeneration.
